setting.help: Approved template used when the cashier sends a quotation by WhatsApp. Its header must be an image: the printed ticket goes there. Leave empty to not offer WhatsApp at this Point of Sale.
setting.invisible: not pos_xb_enable_sale_order or not pos_xb_allow_quotation or not pos_xb_ask_quotation_delivery

setting.help: Approved template sent from the orders list (Sales and Point of Sale) to tell the customer the order is ready. Leave empty to not offer this notice for this company.

Approved template to apologise for a late order and give the customer the new delivery date, sent from the orders list (Sales and Point of Sale). Leave empty to not offer this notice for this company.
Approved template to remind the customer of the balance still due on an order or layaway, sent from the orders list (Sales and Point of Sale). Leave empty to not offer this notice for this company.
Approved template to remind the customer that a ready order is waiting to be picked up, sent from the orders list (Sales and Point of Sale). Leave empty to not offer this notice for this company.

Approved template asking the customer to reply to confirm a detail of the order; once they answer, the seller can write freely. Sent from the orders list (Sales and Point of Sale). Leave empty to not offer this notice for this company.
